title: This Congressman Went From Republican to Independent. But How “Independent” Is He?
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
How does a congressman go from being
[endorsed](https://www.kcra.com/article/former-president-trump-endorses-
rocklins-kevin-kiley-congress/40000280) as a "MAGA champion" by President
Donald Trump to then leaving the party four years later and becoming the
[only](https://www.politico.com/live-updates/2026/03/09/congress/kevin-
kiley-2026-election-independent-00819287) independent in the U.S. House of
Representatives?

**" I've seen just how dysfunctional Congress has become because of the
excessive partisanship that characterizes just everything here," **says **Rep.
Kevin Kiley** - who recently left the Republican party to become an
independent.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

In this interview, **Mehdi** challenges Kiley on his decision to leave the
Republican Party, specifically asking him whether it was because he is now
running for re-election in one of the five California districts Governor Gavin
Newsom
[gerrymandered](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/21/us/politics/california-
newsom-redistricting-texas.html) in favor of Democrats.

The interview is insightful, revealing, and at times contentious. Here are
some of the areas it covers:

  * Why Kiley accepted money from Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson's [Grow the Majority](https://thehill.com/homenews/house/4318611-speaker-johnson-announces-new-joint-fundraising-committee/) fundraising committee

  * What Kiley makes of the Republican party's transformation into a cult of personality around Trump (**" It is not a healthy thing for democracy," **Kiley says)

  * Why Kiley is [against](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/22/us/politics/house-republicans-iran-budget-pentagon.html) providing the Pentagon with more funding for the war on Iran

  * Kiley's [previous](https://www.sacbee.com/news/politics-government/capitol-alert/article316167756.html) non-committal statements on the 2020 election results (**" You couldn't bring yourself to say Joe Biden won fair and square," **Mehdi says)

  * Kiley's legislation to [ban](https://www.npr.org/2026/05/18/nx-s1-5823700/rep-kevin-kiley-i-calif-on-his-bill-to-stop-mid-cycle-redistricting-efforts) mid-decade redistricting and why he did not introduce it before [Proposition 50](https://www.capradio.org/articles/2025/11/05/prop-50-leaves-kevin-kiley-without-a-clear-district-for-2026-run/) split up his district
